blocks.text: 第三季度已经结束！我们现在的年化营收规模已达到五千亿美元，Alphabet 营收增长 25%。

inlines.text: 第三季度已经结束！我们现在的年化营收规模已达到五千亿美元，Alphabet 营收增长 25%。
我们在 AI 上的投资正在推动整体搜索查询量的增长，包括商业查询——我们的查询量同比增长率是过去五年来的最高水平。
Google Cloud 营收增长 103%，这得益于市场对我们 AI 基础设施和 AI 解决方案的超常需求。我们的第一方模型 API 现在每分钟处理近 320 亿个 token（环比增长 40%）。
模型进展势头强劲，Argon 和 Carbon 领跑前沿，Genie 4 是我们迄今最先进的新世界模型。

blocks.text: 感谢我们在世界各地的合作伙伴和员工。电话会议上还有更多内容要分享！

inlines.text: 感谢我们在世界各地的合作伙伴和员工。电话会议上还有更多内容要分享！

blocks.text: Q3 is in the books! We’re now on a half-trillion annual revenue run rate, with Alphabet revenues growing at 25%.

inlines.text: Q3 is in the books! We’re now on a half-trillion annual revenue run rate, with Alphabet revenues growing at 25%.
Our AI investments are driving overall Search query growth, including commercial queries - our YoY query growth rate is the highest it’s been in the last five years.
Google Cloud revenue grew 103%, powered by extraordinary demand for our AI infrastructure and AI solutions. Our 1P model APIs now process nearly 32B tokens/min (up 40% QoQ).
Strong momentum in model progress with Argon and Carbon leading the frontier, and Genie 4 our most advanced new world model yet.

blocks.text: Thanks to our partners and employees around the world. More to share on the call soon!
